**Finding submitted: deviation (LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).**

- **What I found:** No clause uses "liquidated damages" or "penalty," and §18/§23 impose no termination fee payable by us. However, Subparagraph 7.9 (p0154) makes late-paid amounts accrue "extended payment charges" at **300% of the prime-based rate** in 7.8, uncapped in duration — a punitive multiple payable by us, not a compensatory funding cost. That fails the preferred position, and the early-termination-fee fallback doesn't apply.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** strike "three hundred percent (300%) of" so charges accrue at the ordinary Subparagraph 7.8 rate.
- **Noted, not flagged:** §23 default reclamation and non-reimbursement (p0255–p0256) is triggered only by a payment default persisting ~3 months after notice and applies mutually to all Parties; the 7.8 financial charges (capped at 120 days) and the no-credit-on-voluntary-termination rule (p0233) are not Customer-payable penalties.
